rta_weighting.x-help: The RTA bars' time weighting: F (fast), S (slow) or I (impulse).

rta_hold_s.x-help: How long each RTA band holds its peak before the hold falls.

rta_peak_fall_db_s.x-help: How fast a held RTA peak falls; unset drops it straight to the bar.

capture_rate.x-help: The rate this scene captures at; unset uses the installed rate.

crest_window_s.x-help: The span crest factor's peak and RMS are measured over.

stereo_average_s.x-help: The time constant the correlation and balance readings average over.

gradient.x-help: Two or more colour stops, blended across the display.

angle.x-help: The gradient's direction in degrees, as CSS: 180 runs top to bottom.

image.x-help: An image behind the plates, by its id: one uploaded to the host, or one that ships with audio-vue.

blur.x-help: How far the backdrop is blurred, in pixels at a region 1,080 px tall.

saver_after_min.x-help: Minutes without signal before the screensaver; 0 skips it.

sleep_after_min.x-help: Minutes from the screensaver's start before the display sleeps; 0 never.

threshold_lufs.x-help: Momentary loudness at or below this counts as no signal.

value.x-help: The number a card leads with.

caption.x-help: Captions under a scale or a reading.

outline.x-help: A dial's or a shape's boundary.

track.x-help: An unfilled bar, arc or progress track.

series_1.x-help: The first trace, needle or legend.

series_2.x-help: The second trace, needle or legend.

series_3.x-help: The third trace, needle or legend.

bar_body.x-help: A plain bar's body, at its foot.

bar_tip.x-help: A plain bar's tip, at its top.

over.x-help: A reading clipped, over or out of range.

plate.x-help: A mark drawn in the plate's colour.

opacity.x-help: How solid the plates under the cards are, from 0 (clear) to 1 (solid).

radius.x-help: Plate corner radius, in pixels at a region 1,080 px tall.

cols.x-help: Grid columns across the scene's region.

rows.x-help: Grid rows down the scene's region.

gap.x-help: Space between cards, in pixels at a region 1,080 px tall.

signal.x-help: The first series: a trace, a needle, a bar's body.

signal_alt.x-help: The second series, or a bar's tip.

sequence_1.x-help: The first, quietest, of four ordered bands.

sequence_2.x-help: The second of four ordered bands.

sequence_3.x-help: The third of four ordered bands.

sequence_4.x-help: The fourth, loudest, of four ordered bands.

over.x-help: A reading clipped, over or out of range.

centred.x-help: Correlated stereo, which survives a mono sum.

anti_phase.x-help: Inverted stereo, which cancels in a mono sum.

title.x-help: The size every card's title takes.

label.x-help: The size every card's labels take, a table row's value among them.

value.x-help: The size of the number a card leads with.

max_db.x-help: The top of the printed dB scale.

crushed_below_db.x-help: Readings below this show as crushed, by mastering convention.

open_above_db.x-help: Readings above this show as open, by mastering convention.

show_readout.x-help: Print the three readings as numbers too.

show_scale.x-help: Show the scale and the legend.

window_s.x-help: How long one turn of the beam takes, and so how much history the face holds.

band1_color.x-help: Loudness from −30 to −24 LUFS; unset uses the scene's sequence 1.

band2_color.x-help: Loudness from −24 to −18 LUFS; unset uses the scene's sequence 2.

band3_color.x-help: Loudness from −18 to −12 LUFS; unset uses the scene's sequence 3.

band4_color.x-help: Loudness from −12 to −6 LUFS; unset uses the scene's sequence 4.

major_color.x-help: The dial's outer circle; unset uses the scene's outline.

minor_color.x-help: The dial's inner circles and spokes; unset uses the scene's minor grid line.

bar.x-help: The bar's thickness: thick fills a short slot with signal.

style.x-help: Fill from the neutral point, or a single tick at the value.

bar_body_color.x-help: A plain bar's colour at the neutral point; unset uses the scene's bar body.

x-unused-when.reason: This field is coloured by its thresholds: Good, Caution and Over.
This field is coloured by its reading: Wide, Centred and Anti-phase.

bar_tip_color.x-help: A plain bar's colour at the reading; unset uses the scene's bar tip.

x-unused-when.reason: This field is coloured by its thresholds: Good, Caution and Over.
This field is coloured by its reading: Wide, Centred and Anti-phase.

floor_db.x-help: The bottom of the dB scale.

caution_db.x-help: Bars above this show in the caution colour.

over_db.x-help: Bars above this show in the over colour.

hold_s.x-help: How long the peak hold keeps its maximum before it falls.

hold_fall_db_s.x-help: How fast the peak hold falls once its time is up.

show_readout.x-help: Print peak, RMS and crest as numbers.

caution_db.x-help: Bars above this show in the caution colour.

over_db.x-help: Bars above this show in the over colour.

hold_s.x-help: How long the peak hold keeps its maximum before it falls.

hold_fall_db_s.x-help: How fast the peak hold falls once its time is up.

show_readout.x-help: Print peak, RMS and crest as numbers.

show_scale.x-help: Show the scale and its labels.

floor_db.x-help: The bottom of the dBFS scale.

ceiling_db.x-help: The top of the dBFS scale.

major_grid.x-help: Draw a line at each major level.

minor_grid.x-help: Draw a line halfway between the major levels.

major_weight_px.x-help: How thick the major level lines are.

x-unused-when.reason: Major level lines and axis labels are both off.

minor_weight_px.x-help: How thick the minor level lines are.

major_color.x-help: The major lines', baseline's and octave ticks' colour; unset uses the scene's major grid.

x-unused-when.reason: Major level lines and axis labels are both off.

minor_color.x-help: The minor lines' colour; unset uses the scene's minor grid line.

bar_body_color.x-help: Each bar's colour at its foot; unset uses the scene's bar body.

bar_tip_color.x-help: Each bar's colour at its top; unset uses the scene's bar tip.

show_labels.x-help: Label the level and frequency axes.

gap.x-help: The space between bars, as a fraction of each band's width.

alignment.x-help: Where 0 VU sits: EBU R 68 (-18 dBFS), SMPTE RP 155 (-20 dBFS), or custom.

reference_dbfs.x-help: 0 VU in dBFS, used only when the alignment is custom.

x-unused-when.reason: Used only when the alignment is Custom.

lamp_hold_s.x-help: How long the over lamp stays lit after a true-peak over.

show_face.x-help: Show the scale and its labels.

span_s.x-help: How many seconds of the waveform the card shows.

ceiling_db.x-help: The level drawn at full lane height.

show_labels.x-help: Label the level and time axes.

device.x-help: The capture device, as ALSA names it; unset uses the default device.

fmt.x-help: The device's sample format: S16_LE, or S32_LE for 24 bits in 32.

stream_channels.x-help: How many channels the device streams; `pair` picks the two measured.

pair.x-help: Which two of the stream's channels are measured, as left and right.

rate.x-help: The rate the panel captures at.

fixed.x-help: A built-in scene for a process, drawn at the shipped sizes whatever the host sets, and not offered to pick or copy.

col.x-help: The slot's first column, counted from 0 at the left.

row.x-help: The slot's first row, counted from 0 at the top.

colspan.x-help: How many columns the slot spans; unset spans the grid.

rowspan.x-help: How many rows the slot spans; unset spans the grid.

group.x-help: A name shared by slots that together tile one plate.

plate.x-help: This slot's plate colour; unset uses the palette's background.

alternate.x-help: A card drawn in this slot instead while a condition holds.
